div.head: Hn 81
div.ab: (C. LXXXI) De pace regis danda in potatione.
div.note: New row (October 2026): Liebermann’s text transcribed from Gesetze I p. 597 (two independent readings of the page images, differences settled against the page)

note.seg: missverstanden aus domini in 81, 1 (Hausherrn laut 81, 2) nach Pollock Oxford lect. 71. Oder im weitesten Sinne: öffentlicher Ordnungsschutz, also mit pax Dei in 81, 1 synonym

misunderstood from domini in 81, 1 (master of the house, according to 81, 2), according to Pollock Oxford lect. 71. Or in the widest sense: public protection of order, thus synonymous with pax Dei in 81, 1
vgl. 87, 9; Hl 12 ff.; Ine 6, 5; III Atr 1, 2
cf. 87, 9; Hl 12 ff.; Ine 6, 5; III Atr 1, 2
